scope: Public research map for article and landing review. Citations are links, not bundled source text or proof of current coverage.
decision_model: Contextual, evidence-led human assessment. No numeric E-E-A-T score, automatic certification or publication approval.

criteria.title: Reader purpose and useful outcome
criteria.google_basis: Audience usefulness precedes search-first production.
criteria.applies_when: Every article or landing; define the reader task before drafting.
evidence: Audience and task brief
Passages or functionality that complete the task
criteria.review: Compare the brief with the actual answer or offer. Identify what the reader can now understand or do.
criteria.pass: The intended reader outcome is demonstrably served.
criteria.fail: The page promises an outcome but diverts or omits the material answer.
criteria.unknown: Audience or intended decision is not established.
criteria.exception: A commercial CTA is not required for an educational purpose.
criteria.automation_limit: Brief field presence does not demonstrate usefulness.
criteria.article: Identify the question answered and remaining necessary context.
criteria.landing: Identify the offer, audience fit and appropriate next step, including deliberate absence of a CTA.
criteria.gap: Reader-task satisfaction is not independently calibrated.

criteria.title: Risk and expertise threshold
criteria.google_basis: Risk and purpose determine the expertise needed.
criteria.applies_when: Every page receives a scope decision; heightened review applies to potentially harmful advice.
evidence: Risk rationale tied to exact advice
Relevant specialist review where needed
criteria.review: Separate safe personal accounts from prescriptive advice. Document the plausible consequence of an error.
criteria.pass: The assigned reviewer and evidence are appropriate to the advice and potential harm.
criteria.fail: High-impact advice exceeds the substantiated competence or contradicts applicable expert knowledge.
criteria.unknown: Risk or reviewer suitability is unresolved.
criteria.exception: Mentioning money or health does not automatically require identical credentials.
criteria.automation_limit: The YMYL boolean cannot exempt a page from contextual review.
criteria.article: Review recommendations, not just the topic label.
criteria.landing: Review promised outcomes and safety, financial or compliance claims.
criteria.gap: No automated topic classifier or credential verification; reviewer role is an attestation.

criteria.title: First-hand claims are authentic
criteria.google_basis: Relevant first-hand experience can support trust.
criteria.applies_when: The copy claims use, testing, delivery, observation or personal results.
evidence: Dated test notes, project records or original observations
Exact claim and identity of the practitioner
criteria.review: Trace each first-person or organizational experience claim to an actual activity. Separate original work from cited third-party work.
criteria.pass: The described involvement matches the supplied records.
criteria.fail: Research summaries or invented tests are presented as first-hand work.
criteria.unknown: The experience may be real but its supporting record is unavailable.
criteria.exception: An attributed research explainer need not pretend to have personally tested every subject.
criteria.automation_limit: First-person language, photographs or attached files alone cannot authenticate experience.
criteria.article: Distinguish hands-on review from documentation-based explanation.
criteria.landing: Distinguish work delivered from capabilities proposed.
criteria.gap: No dedicated experience ledger or criterion-level reviewer receipt.

criteria.title: Testing and comparison method
criteria.google_basis: Review evidence and method make experience assessable.
criteria.applies_when: Benchmarks, comparisons, product reviews or best-for claims rely on testing.
evidence: Test environment, product version, date and procedure
Measurements and comparison selection rationale
criteria.review: Check that the tested conditions support the comparison. Identify omitted conditions that could reverse the conclusion.
criteria.pass: A reviewer can understand what was compared and why the conclusion follows.
criteria.fail: The comparison conceals materially unequal conditions or reports tests that did not happen.
criteria.unknown: Results are supplied without enough method to interpret them.
criteria.exception: Conditional review guidance is not a universal requirement to run experiments for every article.
criteria.automation_limit: Method field presence does not establish a fair test.
criteria.article: Explain the basis of rankings and recommendations.
criteria.landing: Explain the scope behind comparative performance claims.
criteria.gap: No structured method contract or measurement consistency checker.

criteria.title: Limits and tradeoffs of experience
criteria.google_basis: Useful reviews explain decision factors and tradeoffs.
criteria.applies_when: A recommendation generalizes from observed performance or a case study.
evidence: Conditions of the original case
Relevant drawbacks or unsuitable use cases
criteria.review: Compare the breadth of the recommendation with the scope actually observed.
criteria.pass: The claim is proportionate to the tested or documented situation.
criteria.fail: A limited result is presented as a universal outcome or unsupported guarantee.
criteria.unknown: The bounds of the underlying case are unclear.
criteria.exception: Do not require generic defensive disclaimers where the claim is already accurately scoped.
criteria.automation_limit: A limitations heading cannot prove balanced analysis.
criteria.article: Make recommendation conditions understandable.
criteria.landing: State actual case outcomes without implying guaranteed results for every buyer.
criteria.gap: Scope comparison remains a manual interpretation.

criteria.title: Topic-relevant competence
criteria.google_basis: Competence must fit the subject.
criteria.applies_when: The content relies on specialist knowledge or asserts professional capability.
evidence: Relevant work, training, publications or demonstrated skill
Actual reviewer involvement
criteria.review: Relate the author's or reviewer's knowledge to this claim rather than accepting an unrelated job title.
criteria.pass: Relevant knowledge is demonstrated and named credentials are accurate.
criteria.fail: Credentials are false or irrelevant expertise is used to justify specialist advice.
criteria.unknown: Competence or reviewer participation cannot be substantiated.
criteria.exception: A degree is not mandatory for every subject; practical skill can be pertinent evidence.
criteria.automation_limit: A biography or expert label is not verification.
criteria.article: Check authorship and actual subject review where appropriate.
criteria.landing: Check that team capability claims refer to available, relevant expertise.
criteria.gap: No identity authentication or external credential lookup.

criteria.title: Accuracy and source interpretation
criteria.google_basis: Factual accuracy requires review.
criteria.applies_when: Material factual, technical or advisory statements appear.
evidence: Exact source passage or observation
Claim location and applicable date/version
criteria.review: Read the source in context. Check whether it supports, narrows or contradicts the actual wording.
criteria.pass: Material statements faithfully represent the supporting information.
criteria.fail: A source is misquoted, contradicted or used for a claim it does not establish.
criteria.unknown: An important source is inaccessible, ambiguous or not current enough for the claim.
criteria.exception: Not every sentence needs a citation; distinguish opinion from factual assertions.
criteria.automation_limit: Existing evidence IDs and quote matching do not establish entailment.
criteria.article: Check explanatory claims and recommendations.
criteria.landing: Check benefits, capabilities and claims about customer outcomes.
criteria.gap: No automated factual adjudication; independent semantic calibration remains open.

criteria.title: Demonstrated understanding
criteria.google_basis: Depth and useful analysis matter.
criteria.applies_when: The page explains a concept, process, comparison or service approach.
evidence: Worked explanation, reasoning or practical demonstration
Reader-task completeness review
criteria.review: Identify the useful explanation beyond terminology. Ask whether the intended reader can understand the decision and its conditions.
criteria.pass: The content explains relevant mechanisms and consequences clearly.
criteria.fail: Technical terminology substitutes for a promised explanation or conceals a material gap.
criteria.unknown: The reviewer lacks subject knowledge to judge the explanation.
criteria.exception: Short copy can be complete; do not impose word or diagram counts.
criteria.automation_limit: Readability scores and vocabulary cannot certify expertise.
criteria.article: Assess explanatory completeness for the stated question.
criteria.landing: Assess clarity of the approach, fit and deliverables without demanding a textbook.
criteria.gap: No calibrated reader-comprehension evaluation.

criteria.title: Relevant external reputation
criteria.google_basis: Reputation is topic-specific.
criteria.applies_when: Assessing creator/publisher standing or claims of recognition.
evidence: Independent references, expert recognition or detailed credible reviews
Entity and subject match for each reference
criteria.review: Check the underlying organization or creator across sources. Separate recognition in this topic from unrelated popularity.
criteria.pass: The assessment accurately represents the relevant evidence found, including its limits.
criteria.fail: Recognition is fabricated or materially misrepresented.
criteria.unknown: No reliable reputation evidence is available; this is not automatic low quality.
criteria.exception: Traffic, domain scores and backlink volume are not substitutes for reputation evidence.
criteria.automation_limit: The draft alone cannot establish external authority.
criteria.article: Assess creator and publisher where appropriate.
criteria.landing: Assess the organization and topic-specific capability claims.
criteria.gap: No evidence independence model or entity-reputation research collector.

criteria.title: Independence and provenance of recognition
criteria.google_basis: Self-description differs from independent evidence.
criteria.applies_when: Testimonials, endorsements, awards or media coverage are used as proof.
evidence: Original recognition record
Relationship between publisher, reviewer and subject
criteria.review: Trace the endorsement to its origin and classify it as owned, paid, customer-provided or independent.
criteria.pass: Recognition is authentic and its relationship is represented honestly.
criteria.fail: Paid or self-published promotion is presented as independent validation.
criteria.unknown: The original source or material relationship is unclear.
criteria.exception: A genuine customer testimonial can be useful without being an independent expert assessment.
criteria.automation_limit: A citation link does not establish independence or authenticity.
criteria.article: Disclose the relationship behind quoted endorsements where material.
criteria.landing: Verify testimonials and recognition before presenting them as commercial proof.
criteria.gap: Evidence records have no typed relationship field.

criteria.title: Missing versus adverse reputation
criteria.google_basis: Absent reputation is not negative reputation.
criteria.applies_when: A creator or small organization has limited public recognition.
evidence: Scope and result of reputation research
Other pertinent evidence supporting the page
criteria.review: Record no evidence found separately from credible adverse evidence. Evaluate remaining page evidence in context.
criteria.pass: The review distinguishes missing, positive and adverse evidence correctly.
criteria.fail: The page fabricates recognition or the assessment treats absence as proof of misconduct.
criteria.unknown: Research is insufficient to characterize the available reputation evidence.
criteria.exception: Do not require a new site to have press coverage, backlinks or public reviews to publish.
criteria.automation_limit: Zero records is not a quality verdict.
criteria.article: Allow substantiated contributions by lesser-known authors.
criteria.landing: Evaluate an emerging organization without inventing authority markers.
criteria.gap: No criterion-level distinction between unknown authority and completed contextual review in report output.

criteria.title: Identity and responsibility
criteria.google_basis: Authorship must be honest and appropriate.
criteria.applies_when: Every page needs an appropriate responsible entity; named authorship depends on context.
evidence: Verified author or organizational record
Visible attribution and relevant profile/About information
criteria.review: Compare visible responsibility and credentials with the actual creator, publisher or reviewer.
criteria.pass: Responsibility is clear and identity claims are accurate.
criteria.fail: Invented experts, false credentials or misleading authorship are used.
criteria.unknown: The responsible entity or a claimed reviewer cannot be verified.
criteria.exception: An organization can be the creator of a commercial landing; an individual byline is not universally required.
criteria.automation_limit: A byline, author schema or AI-generated portrait cannot prove identity.
criteria.article: Use accurate attribution where readers expect it.
criteria.landing: Identify the actual organization behind the offer.
criteria.gap: No authenticated identity checks; human verification remains necessary.

criteria.title: Material claims and numeric results
criteria.google_basis: Claims and measurements need accurate support.
criteria.applies_when: Statistics, results, comparisons or promises could influence a decision.
evidence: Raw or approved aggregate data with period, units and denominator
Claim-to-source passage mapping
criteria.review: Recalculate material numbers where possible. Distinguish observation, inference, causation and future targets.
criteria.pass: The result and its scope are supported without misleading attribution.
criteria.fail: Fabricated numbers, incorrect calculations or unsupported causal claims remain.
criteria.unknown: The base data or relevant measurement definition is missing.
criteria.exception: Explicitly labeled projections are not historical outcomes and need stated assumptions.
criteria.automation_limit: The current engine checks references, not arithmetic or causal validity.
criteria.article: Separate reported facts from interpretation and estimates.
criteria.landing: Keep client results distinct from guarantees or general capability statements.
criteria.gap: No structured numeric claim checker or evidence sufficiency model.

criteria.title: Material conflicts and commercial context
criteria.google_basis: Conflicts affect the interpretation of recommendations.
criteria.applies_when: Sponsorship, affiliation, ownership or compensation could influence an endorsement.
evidence: Relevant relationship record
Reader-facing explanation and link qualification where applicable
criteria.review: Compare the recommendation's claimed independence with actual relationships. Review link policy separately from disclosure clarity.
criteria.pass: Material relationships are represented clearly and applicable link policy is satisfied.
criteria.fail: A paid or owned recommendation is misleadingly presented as independent.
criteria.unknown: The relationship cannot be determined.
criteria.exception: A company can describe its own offer; commercial intent alone is not deception.
criteria.automation_limit: A sponsored attribute alone does not disclose every material relationship to readers.
criteria.article: Check review, affiliate and recommendation context.
criteria.landing: Keep own-service positioning distinct from independent endorsements.
criteria.gap: Disclosure adequacy is manual; no relation-aware rule applicability.

criteria.title: Currency and honest updates
criteria.google_basis: Freshness should reflect substance and relevance.
criteria.applies_when: Dates change or time-sensitive claims concern versions, prices, policies or capabilities.
evidence: Version or effective date of evidence
Meaningful revision history for updated claims
criteria.review: Match the claim to the relevant period. Compare displayed updates with substantive changes.
criteria.pass: The time context and stated revisions match the evidence.
criteria.fail: Outdated conditions are presented as current or cosmetic changes imply substantive review.
criteria.unknown: Current applicability or the basis of an update date is unresolved.
criteria.exception: Age alone does not make stable information inaccurate.
criteria.automation_limit: Valid ISO syntax and recent capture dates do not prove current facts.
criteria.article: Check version-sensitive guidance and the update history.
criteria.landing: Check current availability, scope and offer conditions.
criteria.gap: The updated flag alone does not discover undeclared date changes; time-sensitive claim detection remains manual.

criteria.title: Consistent visible copy, metadata and schema
criteria.google_basis: Markup must accurately represent the page.
criteria.applies_when: Metadata or structured data describe the content, creator, offer or results.
evidence: Rendered copy and emitted metadata/schema
Evidence supporting any identities, ratings or outcomes encoded there
criteria.review: Compare promises in titles and descriptions and entities in schema with what readers actually see and what evidence supports.
criteria.pass: The representations agree and do not introduce unsupported claims.
criteria.fail: Invented ratings, credentials or misleading promises occur in markup or metadata.
criteria.unknown: Final CMS output or the relevant feature review is unavailable.
criteria.exception: Schema presence is not mandatory for E-E-A-T and valid JSON is not evidence of authority.
criteria.automation_limit: Syntax passes do not establish semantic accuracy or rich-result eligibility.
criteria.article: Check author, dates, headline and article representations after rendering.
criteria.landing: Check organization, offer and testimonial representations after rendering.
criteria.gap: Feature-specific schema validation and semantic comparison remain incomplete.

criteria.title: Appropriate accountability and user protection
criteria.google_basis: Trust needs vary with site purpose and transactions.
criteria.applies_when: A page or connected flow collects information, handles transactions or makes support commitments.
evidence: Relevant contact, service and data-handling information
Staging test record for the actual user flow using synthetic data
criteria.review: Identify what the user is asked to provide or rely on. Verify that the responsible party and relevant conditions are understandable.
criteria.pass: The flow and accountability are appropriate to its purpose and stated commitments.
criteria.fail: Material conditions are deceptive or the promised help cannot be accessed.
criteria.unknown: The actual flow or applicable policy evidence has not been reviewed.
criteria.exception: An educational community does not need a sales contact form or personal home address to demonstrate trust.
criteria.automation_limit: A link or form element cannot establish operational safety, privacy compliance or support quality.
criteria.article: Review relevant subscription or download flows without imposing lead capture.
criteria.landing: Review the intended enquiry, transaction or community flow in context.
criteria.gap: No dedicated contextual accountability/safety rule; requires a proposed rule and independent tests before enforcement.

criteria.title: Original contribution rather than rewritten sources
criteria.google_basis: Original contribution matters beyond attribution.
criteria.applies_when: Every substantive article or landing.
evidence: Specific original contribution
Relevant source or sibling-page comparison
criteria.review: Name what this page adds for its reader. Distinguish shared templates from substantively interchangeable content.
criteria.pass: The page has a useful, identifiable contribution appropriate to its purpose.
criteria.fail: Rephrasing or page variants substitute for a promised useful contribution.
criteria.unknown: Relevant source or sibling content is unavailable for comparison.
criteria.exception: Shared components and AI assistance are not inherently low quality or spam.
criteria.automation_limit: Similarity percentages and citation counts do not determine originality or abuse.
criteria.article: Identify analysis, explanation, research or experience beyond the sources.
criteria.landing: Identify distinct audience, problem, offer or evidence beyond sibling pages.
criteria.gap: Cross-page evidence inventory and independent originality evaluation remain open.

criteria.title: Honest production method and AI-assisted review
criteria.google_basis: Production context and accuracy deserve review.
criteria.applies_when: Production method affects reader understanding or AI substantially contributes to factual content.
evidence: Actual production and human review record
Context disclosure where reasonably expected
criteria.review: Verify what research, testing and human checking actually happened. Decide whether explaining automation would help readers interpret the work.
criteria.pass: The production account is truthful and material generated claims have been checked.
criteria.fail: Generated content is presented as nonexistent personal testing or a fabricated human review.
criteria.unknown: The production or fact-checking record cannot be established.
criteria.exception: Do not mandate a blanket AI label for every editorial assistance step or apply Merchant Center rules to ordinary articles.
criteria.automation_limit: An AI-text detector cannot establish provenance or quality.
criteria.article: Explain relevant research/testing methods and check generated facts.
criteria.landing: Verify generated claims and do not invent customer or staff experience.
criteria.gap: Factual review exists, but production-method/disclosure adequacy has no dedicated rule.

criteria.title: Accessible, usable main content
criteria.google_basis: Main content must serve its purpose.
criteria.applies_when: Reviewing the rendered article, landing or useful media/tool content.
evidence: Rendered reading and interaction review
Accessible alternatives for meaningful visuals
criteria.review: Read the final page and inspect relevant media or interactions. Identify obstruction, misleading visuals and omitted alternatives.
criteria.pass: Readers can find, understand and use the main content for its intended purpose.
criteria.fail: Obstruction, misleading media or broken essential interaction prevents that outcome.
criteria.unknown: Rendered or interaction evidence is missing.
criteria.exception: A video, chart, polished design or longer page is not inherently more authoritative.
criteria.automation_limit: Markup inventory cannot certify visual usability, accessibility conformance or trust.
criteria.article: Check the reading experience and supporting illustrations.
criteria.landing: Check offer comprehension and the intended next action.
criteria.gap: Rendered evidence is imported, not independently collected or comprehensively assessed.
